Bart Verbruggen.note: Verbruggen has been Netherlands's goalkeeper through this run. His value is keeping the box calm long enough for the next attack to start cleanly.
Bart Verbruggen.noteZh: 他给Netherlands提供从后场开始的冷静第一步。看他如何把扑救或摘球变成重新组织。

Brian Brobbey.note: Brobbey has already punished Sweden and Tunisia for Netherlands. The watch point is how little room he needs once the chance is alive.
Brian Brobbey.noteZh: 他已经是Netherlands这届世界杯的真实得分故事之一。他的危险在于防守者还没处理完第一个问题，他已经到位。

Cody Gakpo.note: Gakpo has already shaped Netherlands's tournament with goals against Sweden and Morocco and service for teammates. Watch how quickly his next action follows the first touch.
Cody Gakpo.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经同时给Netherlands带来终结和传球。防守者不能只防他的一种选择。

Crysencio Summerville.note: Summerville has put goals and service into Netherlands's tournament, with finishes against Japan and Sweden. His card is the next action after the first touch.
Crysencio Summerville.noteZh: 他已经把进球和助攻都放进了Netherlands的赛事故事里。看点是第一脚之后，第二个动作有多快。

Denzel Dumfries.note: Dumfries has already created a goal for Netherlands in this tournament. Watch the timing of his release, because the pass often matters more than the carry.
Denzel Dumfries.noteZh: 他已经参与了Netherlands的一粒世界杯进球。那脚传球的意义，是在防守者完全转身前到达。

Donyell Malen.note: Malen has been part of how Netherlands turns territory into chances. Watch the run before the pass, not only the shot after it.
Donyell Malen.noteZh: 他是Netherlands的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Frenkie de Jong.note: Jong has been one of Netherlands's players who keeps possessions from fraying. The detail to watch is how early he knows the next pass.
Frenkie de Jong.noteZh: 他是Netherlands这届赛事中的中场连接点之一。他让下一脚传球继续存在，也帮助球队避免仓促选择。

Guus Til.note: Til gives Netherlands a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Guus Til.noteZh: 他是Netherlands的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Jan Paul van Hecke.note: Hecke's World Cup has already included a goal against Tunisia. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Jan Paul van Hecke.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Jorrel Hato.note: Hato is defensive cover for Netherlands's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Jorrel Hato.noteZh: 他是Netherlands在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Justin Kluivert.note: Kluivert gives Netherlands a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Justin Kluivert.noteZh: 他是Netherlands的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Lutsharel Geertruida.note: Geertruida is defensive cover for Netherlands's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Lutsharel Geertruida.noteZh: 他是Netherlands在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Mark Flekken.note: Flekken sits behind the starter for Netherlands, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Mark Flekken.noteZh: 他给Netherlands保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Marten de Roon.note: Roon is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Netherlands, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Marten de Roon.noteZh: 他给Netherlands提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Mats Wieffer.note: Wieffer is back-line insurance for Netherlands. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Mats Wieffer.noteZh: 他给Netherlands那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Memphis Depay.note: Depay has one tournament assist in the bank for Netherlands. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Memphis Depay.noteZh: 他已经帮Netherlands制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Micky van de Ven.note: Ven is in the quiet-work part of Netherlands's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Micky van de Ven.noteZh: 他是Netherlands主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Nathan Ake.note: Aké gives Netherlands another way to protect the edge of the box. His value shows up when the obvious pass disappears.
Nathan Ake.noteZh: 他给Netherlands那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Noa Lang.note: Lang is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Netherlands, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Noa Lang.noteZh: 他给Netherlands提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Quinten Timber.note: Timber gives Netherlands a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Quinten Timber.noteZh: 他是Netherlands的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Robin Roefs.noteZh: 他给Netherlands保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Ryan Gravenberch.note: Gravenberch has already made goals for Netherlands against Japan. Watch the pass before the chance looks obvious.
Ryan Gravenberch.noteZh: 他已经多次帮Netherlands制造进球。看的是明显机会出现前的那脚传球。

Teun Koopmeiners.note: Koopmeiners is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Netherlands, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Teun Koopmeiners.noteZh: 他给Netherlands提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Tijjani Reijnders.note: Reijnders has already created a goal for Netherlands in this tournament. Watch the timing of his release, because the pass often matters more than the carry.
Tijjani Reijnders.noteZh: 他已经参与了Netherlands的一粒世界杯进球。那脚传球的意义，是在防守者完全转身前到达。

Virgil van Dijk.note: Dijk has already given Netherlands a goal and a setup in this tournament. Defenders have to read shot and pass at the same time.
Virgil van Dijk.noteZh: 他在这段征程中既进球也创造机会。同一次跑动，可能变成射门，也可能变成射门前的一脚传球。

Wout Weghorst.note: Weghorst is an attacking change-up for Netherlands. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Wout Weghorst.noteZh: 他是Netherlands的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。
